descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Rikuzen shidare' Rare Weeping Japanese Maple From Japan Zones 5-9 ‘Rikuzen shidare’ is a selection of Japanese maple with the large green leaves of the Acer amoenum. The habit is unlike many with such large leaves. ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ is extremely weeping. Like many amazing selections from Japan, this tree originated at a temple. Noticed by many as being unique, the original tree stood at temple in the Rikuzen province of Japan. From what I can best understand, in 2011, a tsunami hit the area and destroyed the original tree. Luckily some nurseryman had grafted this selection, which saved this tree from being completely lost. Unlike ‘Ryusen’, ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ has leaves similar to the size of ‘Osakazuki’, but instead of turning red in the fall, ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ turns to bright shade of yellow. When we visited Minoh Park in Japan, we learned something incredible about Japanese maples with yellow fall color. According to expert Setsuko Hisakuni, the Japanese maples with large leaves and yellow fall color make the best fried maples leaves, known as momiji tempura. Apparently, the red fall color creates a bitter taste, which the Japanese maples with yellow fall color avoid. While not everyone has room to grow a large growing green Japanese maple with yellow fall color to try to grow your own tree for fried momiji tempura, the smaller weeping habit of ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ allows anyone to grow their own in a smaller container. We recommend staking ‘ Rikuzen shidare’ for the best shape. The main photo is 'Rikuzen shidare' in a 15 gallon size container showing fall color in Japan.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Rikuzen shidare'，来自日本的珍稀垂枝日本枫，适生区 5-9。‘Rikuzen shidare’ 是一个日本枫选育品种，具有 Acer amoenum 类型的大型绿色叶片。它的树形与许多同样具大叶的品种不同，呈极强的下垂姿态。和许多来自日本的优秀品种一样，这棵树最初出自寺庙。因其独特性受到关注，原始母树曾生长在日本陆前国的一座寺庙中。据目前可知，2011 年当地海啸摧毁了原树。幸运的是，已有苗圃业者提前对该品种进行了嫁接繁殖，使这一品种得以保存，没有彻底失传。与 ‘Ryusen’ 不同，‘Rikuzen shidare’ 的叶片大小更接近 ‘Osakazuki’，但秋季不是转红，而是转为明亮的黄色。我们在日本箕面公园访问时，了解到关于黄秋色日本枫的一件很有意思的事。根据专家 Setsuko Hisakuni 的说法，叶片较大且秋色为黄色的日本枫最适合制作炸枫叶，也就是 momiji tempura。红叶秋色会带来苦味，而黄叶秋色的日本枫则可避免这一点。并非每个人都有空间栽培大型绿叶黄秋色日本枫来尝试自制炸 momiji tempura，但 ‘Rikuzen shidare’ 较小的垂枝习性，使任何人都可以在较小容器中栽培它。我们建议对 ‘Rikuzen shidare’ 进行支撑牵引，以获得最佳树形。主图为日本一株 15 加仑容器规格的 ‘Rikuzen shidare’，展示其秋季叶色。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。建议您看到心仪品种及时购买，因为部分精选品种常常很快售罄。
